title: Introduce cross-shot consistency scalers and prompt-set rollback advisor
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds a cross-shot consistency scaler metric and a prompt-set rollback advisor that suggests targeted rollback ranges when regressions are detected. Backwards-compatible: no user-facing API changes.
description:
Context and motivation: We observed several regressions that only appear when aggregating across multiple in-context shots (1/3/5) where models stayed stable per-shot but drifted in relative ordering across shots. Current gates focus on per-shot absolute metrics and cohort averages, which miss inter-shot instability that causes downstream incoherence in multi-shot UI flows. This PR implements a cross-shot consistency scaler, adds it to the CI eval pipeline as a gated metric, and wires a lightweight rollback advisor that points to prompt-subset windows likely responsible for the shift.

Changes included (single-string summary):
- New metric module eval/metrics/cross_shot_consistency.py that computes pairwise rank-consistency and a normalized scaler across shot counts.
- Integration hook eval/ci/hooks/cross_shot_gate.py which exposes gating thresholds and a sampling config.
- Rollback advisor tooling in eval/tools/rollback_advisor.py that analyzes cohort deltas and suggests contiguous prompt-set ranges to consider for rollback/backfill.
- Unit and integration tests: tests/metrics/test_cross_shot_consistency.py and tests/ci/test_cross_shot_gate_integration.py.
- Documentation and changelog snippet in docs/ci-gates.md and docs/metrics.md.

Design notes and rationale: The cross-shot scaler is intentionally distribution-aware: it computes Kendall-tau-like agreement across model outputs after normalization to handle score-scale differences across variants. We produce both a raw agreement score and a normalized scaler in [0,1] that can be thresholded in CI. Thresholds are calibrated empirically using the last three months of canary/eval runs; defaults are conservative (only fail CI when scaler drops by >6 percentage points relative to anchor). The rollback advisor uses a sliding-window delta aggregation across prompt-version timestamps to surface contiguous windows where the scaler regression is concentrated. It prioritizes windows by combined impact (delta * size) and outputs a short list of candidate ranges with a confidence score.

Compatibility and rollout: The feature is opt-in behind the eval_pipeline config flag cross_shot_gating.enabled=false by default; we enabled it in a Canary pipeline for the runtime team for two weeks before broad rollout. No model-serving changes required.

Testing and benchmarks: Local unit tests cover degenerate cases (identical outputs across shots, single-shot) and randomized property tests assert symmetry and idempotence. Integration run on CI smoke with 1k sample cohort measured ~12ms additional wall time per 512-sample batch; memory overhead negligible. We ran the gated hook against historical anchors and observed it flagged 3 known incidents (internal: LR-2024-07, regression-candidate dates included) while producing no false positives on 15 stable releases.
